notes.title: Small Localization Fix
notes.content: Added a few extra localization options.

notes.title: v0.42 - More Localization Tweaks
notes.content:
Added the option to add the size paramater in a localization tag:

<text key="STARDUST_OFFICE" size="16">STARDUST OFFICE</text>

This means you can override the default font size to deal with long words by making the font smaller.

Also when the system cannot load a localization file it shows an error message in game rather than just having all the text say ERROR. This error msg should help you find the mistake in your localization file.

notes.title: MGZ: Nursery Update!
notes.content:
There is a new area in the star base laboratory, it was designed for you to hatch and raise your stars. It includes a new mini game, new setting, new NPC's and with a new set of actions that brings along a brand new difficulty.

Instead of playing the old hand guessing game, now there is Baby Game. Each time you need to replenish your Baby Star's mood you can play a dot connecting game, the trick is to connect all the dots and also fill in the board completely. Its a fun logic puzzle, and each time you play there is a randomly generated board. 

Features are similar from the ones we had before, but now you must educate, feed and look after you pet carefully or they can flee the lab. We are removing the death of stars, and instead replaced it with losing pets into space. Hatching new stars will cost extra in game Zoot.

Baby Stars aren't fully aware of themselves, that's why Stardust's OWO Operating System will come in handy to assist every single step of the way letting you know what your pet needs. Stars now read books and collect allowance as they grow. We are also including a new mini-game available with the nursery.

We are testing interactive background design which includes a new robot in the Matchyverse! Introducing Red, he will be helping along bringing cuteness into the game. It's still under construction but it is available now for you to play and provide feedback as we build it.

notes.title: Big Zoot Update!
notes.content:
We've spent a lot of time working out the economy for the food upgrades in Matchymart and now there is no limit to the amount of Zoot you can collect.

[list]
[*]Fix bugs on older machines.
[*]Add interactive elements to splash screen.
[*]You can interact with, throw and move, coins in Xanadu and the splash screen.
[*]Zoot is rendered as big numbers with suffixes for very high values.
[*]Food can be upgraded in Matchymart.
[*]You can build special ships that are worth tons of Zoot.
[*]Special ships value can be upgraded.
[*]Salad takes longer to digest than other food and is up-gradable.
[*]Corndog gives you a chance to build a big ship worth more.
[*]Eating a snack transforms you into that snack.
[*]Snacks help you train your pet by forcing them to do personality actions.
[*]There is a thought gear between personality actions to help you train your Star.
[*]You can collect Xanadu Coins for earning tons of Zoot.
[*]Add polish to text elements, shadows and layering are correct.
[*]Tweak sugar rush cap value.
[*]The care level you give Stars affects even high level Stars.
[*]Clicking Zee's nametag and glasses has better effects.
[*]Clean up sprite hit boxes.
[*]Cash SFX only occurs on big purchases.
[*]Back button is consistent: always upper right.
[/list]

Phew! That's a lot of fixes, upgrades, and polish. I recommend you do a hard reset in the settings menu and try to earn the new upgrades in the order they are given out, but its not required.

We'd love to hear your feedback on the new build, and we'll fix anything that is broken so hit us up in https://discord.silverwaregames.com our Discord server to let us know if you have any feedback. Our social links are listed below too!

-Michael, Big Cheesy Potato.

notes.title: MGZ Updates!
notes.content:
Last year we ran into a critical error in the build which caused a lot of heartache to resolve. It was mostly a graphical glitch that caused older desktops to crash.

Every single time we tried to update we would run into the same problem. We had to revise our new sprite system, fixing a memory leak in the process and had to rewrite the entire system as we found no solution through Unity's code. It was more effective as it loads faster now, but that -still- didn't fix the problem. The menu window would instantly crash the game as a visual glitch in older computers. Eventually, we had to rewrite the parsing code after testing hundreds of builds to finally make the build run smoothly again. 

It took us months to work this out, but we finally did! If you would like to read up on more about this programming headache then [url=https://matchyverse.com/index.php/2020/03/05/the-big-bug/]read on Michael's entry about it right here.[/url] 

Now we move forward with more Early Access updates. We are currently working on:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33621496/da956e4767beda361158ecdce7cacc37982180d1.png[/img]
- Improved MatchyMart / Zootlandia notifications.
- Optimizing negative effects, like sugar rush.
- More UI feedback for games to tell you how well you are doing. 
- Thought gear for between star actions. It will be helpful for training personalities.
- Ships fly off to the left instead of flying on top of star. Visual aesthetic suggestions we are taking care of now.
- And the big economy overhaul: balancing out the economy of the game so it feels a bigger impact on the value of ships you produce as well as the food effects.

In terms of new content, we are working on:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33621496/11775603a0f0269eb2552eb066bf0c886c49fec6.png[/img]
- New background areas for the laboratory.
- New MatchyMart area: the wardrobe area.
- New mini-games with new MatchyMart store customization.

Hopefully we will be able to wrap up a new build soon enough and have your feedback on it. More updates coming ahead :)

-Say ʕ•ᴥ•ʔﾉ♡
Silverware Games Derpy Wasabi

notes.title: ☆ Early Access Updates ☆
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/c127ef08a00eb032b79225350d8fa24d964b9a96.png[/img]

Henlo!

Happy to share that a new build goes up today and it features:

- Whole new sprite system which makes it easier for us to update the build. Had to reorganize over 200 sprites to make this work! It's optimization to make future updates easier.

- Important UI tweaks: different buttons / sliders, icons black out correctly.

Also, it includes:

- New music for Stardust, Zootlandia, and MatchyMart.

- New MatchyMart items. Introducing different cups for the cup game, each plays differently.

- And last but not least! New bug progression, each time you clean there are different bugs with different properties, including the BOSS BUG.

We will be showing the build via Twitch before it becomes available, that way we can show you all these things real time and hang out as we make the new build available.

Instead of making but chunks of updates every now and then, we figured we would make more frequent and smaller updates, and to keep up with this, we are scheduling live streams weekly during early access. This means, we hope to go live [b]every Monday at 8pm EST[/b] as we work and push new content as it goes!

[b]Feel free to join us tonight ～☆ https://www.twitch.tv/silverwaregames[/b]
